vocab.definition: the single force that has the same effect as all forces.
the force of gravity on a mass; W = m × g.
the rate of change of velocity, in m/s².
steady speed when drag balances weight.

misconceptions.wrong: A moving object always has a force pushing it.
misconceptions.right: At constant speed, forces are balanced.

misconceptions.wrong: Mass and weight are the same thing.
misconceptions.right: Mass is in kg; weight is a force in newtons.
Without air, all objects fall at the same rate.

infoPanels.title: FORCES ON A MOVING OBJECT
infoPanels.secondaryContent: If thrust = drag and reaction = weight, the resultant force is zero.

questions.text: A 6 kg mass sits on Earth (g = 9.8 N/kg). Calculate its weight. [2 marks]
A resultant force of 12 N acts on a 4 kg trolley. Calculate its acceleration (F = m a). [2 marks]
Explain what happens to a car's motion when the driving force equals the drag. [2 marks]
Explain why a skydiver reaches a terminal velocity. [3 marks]
Complete the sentence using the word bank. [2 marks]
questions.secondaryText: When forces are balanced the resultant force is ______ and the object moves at a ______ velocity.

questions.text: Stopping distance = thinking distance + braking distance. State one factor that increases each. [2 marks]

footer.tip: Resultant force = mass × acceleration (F = m a).
